title: Aspiring filmmaker here. I have a question.

commenti.body:
Hi, aspiring writer here! 

I would give the first concept a solid 8/10, but I think that you would have to be careful with how you craft the story, lest it come off as insensitive and whatnot, which would ruin the emotional impact of it. This one is a good idea.

 I like the second concept too, but it seems kind of bare bones. 6-7/10? My opinion would be that the tunnel should be a metaphor for something relevant to the two friends, and as they get further in they start to come to the realization of what it is. Maybe the relationship is being strained by one of them moving, and the endless tunnel is a representation of the others idea of how their friendship was going to be, and the end of the tunnel it’s the realization that things change. 

The third one is weird to me. The concept initially made me make a face, but I can totally see it become a cult classic if made correctly. The character of the stripper would have to be pretty vindictive to raid the hospital over the denial, even though that is soul-crushing news to them. I don’t think I can rate this one because I can’t fully envision it, but it’s alright.

The fourth one is alright. I would give it a middle of the road 5/10 with the information given. What is the life changing truth? What do the poems mean? Without this I can’t really figure out where this one would go.

The first two are definitely my favorites. I hope this was helpful!
